reasons: Mean adjudicated supplied-gene function coverage improved by 13.0 percentage points.
All eight paired sessions improved; all four paired cases improved by 8.7 to 17.4 percentage points.
Wrong-gene and paralog-only flags each fell from 5 to 1, and wrong-function flags fell from 17 to 7.
Context overclaim was flat, but contradictions increased from 0 to 2 and fail the strict non-regression gate.
Known accepted-run API-equivalent cost was at least 3.23x baseline.
The workflow required recovery for one of eight sessions and exposed SDK telemetry gaps.
next_actions: Deduplicate supplied-gene queries across themes and reuse verified paper-gene edges.
Cap or prioritize the regulator pass for large regulator sets.
Stop once every supplied gene has a terminal evidence state and the gap phase is complete.
Conservatively canonicalize malformed mechanism-level support instead of spending a blind retry.
Add a direction-aware conflict check and qualify evidence by species, developmental state, and disease state.
Re-run the paired pilot at 60 turns, $1.25, and 900 seconds after work reduction; use six concurrent sessions per provider for model assessment.
Require contradictions to return to baseline and cost plus p95 latency to be at most 1.5x before changing production defaults.
